notes_for_editor: Single register entry. No build date, builder, original site or move date. The register gives Camp Charlotte background but does not tie the camp to the tower, so the story keeps them apart. Searches and the Encyclopedia of Arkansas CCC entry and Preserve Arkansas lookout page do not mention the Charlotte tower. Leads: CCC camp records for Company 4735-C, Independence County fire-tower histories, and the ranch's own pages for when the tower arrived. Private property; do not encourage climbing.
